AI.heading: AI that reasons like a care team
AI.paragraph1: Most health apps track a single metric. xHeal connects all of them.
AI.paragraph2: Our AI interprets your data through clinical guidelines from the WHO, ADA, and EASD, the same standards your care team uses. But unlike any single specialist, your Digital Twin sees everything at once: your labs, your sleep, your symptoms, your habits, your history.
AI.paragraph3: The result? Patterns spotted earlier. Connections made faster. Answers grounded in your data, not generic advice.

About.teamHeading: Built by technical and healthcare experts

event1.title: xHeal v2 launches in EU and USA.
event1.description: Enhanced AI-native interface. Available for users across Europe and the United States. 160 features in the backlog waiting to be enabled. We go real!

event2.title: New Year's resolution. Prove it works.
event2.description: Trifon and the team launched 12-week personal validation programs with xHeal - putting themselves on the line to prove that a digital healthcare twin can be successful and genuinely helpful.

event3.title: First 1,000 users. Time for v2.
event3.description: xHeal hit its first 1,000 users outside of alpha and beta testing. The feedback was in - and it was invaluable. The team had everything they needed to craft a top-notch UX and build v2 of the AI-native interface.

event4.title: AWS Partnership.
event4.description: xHeal became an AWS Partner and joined their startup credits program.

event5.title: xHeal v1 released in the USA.
event5.description: The first version goes live for American users.

event6.title: The moment it got real.
event6.description: The first predictive suggestion - not based on historical data. During beta testing, xHeal suggested Trifon check his HOMA-IR levels. The result: elevated - early-stage insulin resistance. The technology had caught something he didn't know he had. This wasn't just an idea anymore. It worked.

event7.title: Alpha testing. 95% accuracy.
event7.description: The team launched predictive models and AI-generated diagnostics against ~5,000 real patients who volunteered to check their diagnosis against xHeal's algorithms. The result: 95% accuracy. Unfortunately, their diagnoses were confirmed. The technology could see what doctors already knew. But could it see what they didn't?

event8.title: xHeal Corp. founded in Miami.
event8.description: The company was officially incorporated in Florida, USA. Headquarters: Miami baby.

event9.title: Going global. Enter Nikolay Miami.
event9.description: The team knew this technology belonged in the American market. But they needed local presence - and someone who could define the marketing strategy and sales narrative. That's when they contacted Nikolay Nedyalkov. He joined as Co-Founder and CSO - their top-notch salesman in Miami. He was in.

event10.title: Enter Nikolay. The missing piece.
event10.description: Nikolay joined as Co-Founder and Head of AI. His deep ML expertise was exactly what xHeal needed. His family - with extensive medical backgrounds - became trusted advisors. The founding team was now complete.

event11.title: The first commit.
event11.description: The first line of code was written. Kris made the initial commit to the xHeal v2 repository. The team wasn't chasing the AI hype - they were convinced they could build something real: a healthcare companion that learns from you, like a digital twin. They took the challenge head-on, aiming for a 100% AI-powered backend.

event12.title: The team comes together.
event12.description: Trifon shared his vision with Kris and Kalin. Both had gone through their own health struggles and instantly resonated with the idea. The founding team was born. A promise was made: No one should have to go through this alone.

event13.title: Four years of searching. The answer.
event13.description: After four years of reading mountains of medical literature and trying unorthodox methods, Trifon finally discovered the underlying issue: dysbiosis - his gut bacteria were completely out of balance. A disrupted gut microbiome was fueling the chronic inflammation. Once he understood the pattern, he found his way back to health.

event14.title: It started with a personal crisis.
event14.description: In 2019, at just 27 years old, Trifon faced recurring prostatitis inflammation that turned his life upside down. Nine rounds of antibiotics, one after the other, left his immune system shattered. He felt miserable - exhausted, lost, and desperate for answers. He visited countless doctors and specialists, both in Bulgaria and abroad. No one could pinpoint the root cause. So he took matters into his own hands.

trifon.name: Trifon Getsov
trifon.bio: 3x CEO, entrepreneur, solutions architect, and engineer with successful ventures in biotechnology and product development. Passionate about motivating people, building exceptional teams, and solving ridiculously complex problems.

kristiyan.name: Kristiyan Nikolov
kristiyan.bio: Exceptional systems engineer, cloud architect, and DevOps specialist with deep expertise in distributed systems and large-scale platform automation serving millions of users.

kalin.name: Kalin Stoev
kalin.bio: Specializes in React Native, full-stack engineering, and mobile-first architecture. Deep expertise in real-time sync, health data integrations, and scalable cross-platform solutions.

nikolayK.name: Nikolay Kolibarov
nikolayK.bio: Specializes in AI architectures, ML pipelines, computer vision, and DevOps. Brings hands-on experience building scalable, cloud-native AI solutions and real-time analytics platforms.

rayna.name: Rayna Mihaylova, MD
rayna.bio: Dr. Rayna Mihaylova is a pediatrician who graduated from Medical University Varna. She currently cares for over 3,000 patients in Bulgaria, treating children from infancy through adolescence. Her background includes international experience in Greece and ongoing training through conferences and specialized pediatric programs.

nikolayM.name: Nikolay M. Kolibarov, MD
nikolayM.bio: Dr. Nikolay M. Kolibarov is an obstetrician-gynecologist specializing in obstetrics, gynecology, and reproductive medicine. He graduated from Medical University of Varna and has expanded his expertise through international conferences, specialized training, and clinical work in South Africa. He currently serves as Managing Director of Municipal Hospital Karnobat in Bulgaria.

Support.faqDescription: If you have any additional questions, please don't hesitate to email us at
Support.faq1Answer: xHeal Chat is your AI-powered health companion. It can answer your questions, explain your scores and reports, help you track symptoms, and guide you with personalized recommendations, making your health journey easier and more interactive.
Support.faq2Answer: Records is your secure digital space where all your personal health documents are stored. It centralizes medical records, test results, and other health-related information, making it easy for you to access and manage your data in one place.
Support.faq3Answer: Routines are daily or weekly actions like tracking your steps, logging meals, or practicing relaxation exercises that support your health goals. They help build lasting habits, boost your xHeal Score, and keep you on track toward better wellbeing.
Support.faq4Answer: The xHeal Report is a personalized health summary that pulls together your scores, vitals, and flare-up history. It transforms raw data into simple, actionable insights that you can share with healthcare professionals or use for self-improvement.
Support.faq5Answer: Vitals are your key health measurements, such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, weight, and more. Monitoring them regularly provides insights into your baseline health and makes it easier to notice changes or irregularities.
Support.faq6Answer: Flare-Up Tracking allows you to log symptoms like headaches, fatigue, digestive issues, or other recurring conditions. Over time, the app identifies patterns and possible triggers, helping you and your care team better understand and manage your flare-ups.
Support.faq7Answer: Indicator Tracking helps you stay ahead of potential health issues. By analyzing your vitals, lifestyle inputs, and medical data, it highlights early warning signs and possible risks. This allows you to take proactive measures before problems become serious.
Support.faq8Question: What is the Health Awareness Score?
Support.faq8Answer: The Health Awareness Score reflects how engaged you are with your health journey. It increases as you track routines, complete reports, and stay consistent with your health check-ins. It's designed to motivate you to take small but meaningful steps every day.
Support.faq9Answer: The xHeal Score is your overall wellness index. It combines data from your vitals, medical records, routines, and flare-up tracking to give you a single, easy-to-understand view of your current health state. The higher the score, the more balanced your wellbeing.

Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.heroSubtitle: Your Digital Twin knows your vitals, lab results, symptoms, and daily habits. Ask it anything - and get answers you can actually use.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.heroImageAlt: xHeal Chat - ask your Digital Twin about your health data and get personalised answers
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.painHeading: You have the data. You just can’t get <accent>answers from it.</accent>
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.pain1Detail: Your vitals live in Apple Health. Labs in a PDF. Medications in a note. Diet in a third app. When something feels off, you’re the one stitching it all together.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.pain2Detail: A resting heart rate of 72, HRV of 38, ferritin of 15. What do they mean together? Without context, health data is just noise you can’t act on.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.pain3Detail: You notice a pattern – fatigue after meals, worse sleep on stressful days – but your next appointment is weeks away. The question just sits there.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.how1Description: Type a question in plain language. “Why am I so tired?” “What were my vitals last month?” “Should I change my routine?” No medical jargon needed.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.how2Title: Your Digital Twin reads your full picture
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.how2Description: xHeal instantly scans your medical records, lab results, wearable data, symptom logs, and lifestyle inputs to find the context that matters for your question.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.how3Description: No jargon. No vague suggestions. xHeal responds with plain-language explanations, specific next steps, and direct references to your data so you know exactly what it’s based on.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.useCasesHeading: Questions your Digital Twin <accent>can answer right now</accent>
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc1Question: What were my vitals last month?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc1Description: Pull any metric from any point in your health timeline. No scrolling, no searching for old files.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc2Description: xHeal cross-references symptoms, sleep, stress, nutrition, and activity to surface triggers you’d never spot alone.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc3Question: Which labs should I ask for next?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc3Description: Based on your profile and results, xHeal identifies gaps and recommends specific tests to bring to your next appointment.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc4Question: What should I focus on this week?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc4Description: Get a weekly priority based on your current trends and goals – so you always know what matters most right now.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc5Question: How has my sleep affected my energy?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc5Description: See how changes in one area ripple across others. Sleep to energy, mood to activity, stress to symptoms.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc6Description: Upload a PDF or photo. xHeal reads, stores, and explains each marker in the context of your full health picture.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.compIntro: Most health tools stop at tracking. They show you numbers but never explain what they mean together. Your Digital Twin doesn’t just store your data. It reads it, connects it, and talks to you about it.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.compRow9Feature: Generates reports for your care team
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.compClosingLine: WHOOP shows you numbers. Bevel and Olivia give you basic answers. xHeal connects 250+ parameters to tell you what your health actually means.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.test1Quote: I asked my Digital Twin why I felt tired after 8 hours of sleep. It connected my HRV data to my late dinner timing. Mind blown.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.test2Quote: My Digital Twin knows me better than any single doctor because it has all my data in one place. That’s not an exaggeration.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.test3Quote: The AI chat doesn’t just answer, it explains the reasoning. WHO guidelines, my personal data, everything cited. It’s like having a medical advisor.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust1Detail: Our AI partner does not store your messages and never uses them for training. Your conversation exists only while you’re in it.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust2Detail: Every answer references WHO, ADA, and EASD clinical guidelines, the same frameworks your care team uses.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust3Detail: Delete any conversation or your entire chat history from the app. No questions asked, no hidden copies.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust4Title: Minimal data in, maximum context out
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust4Detail: We send only de-identified signals needed to answer your question. Your name, identity, and full records never leave your device.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq1Q: Is this a replacement for my doctor?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq1A: No. xHeal Chat is a health companion, not a medical provider. It helps you understand your data, spot patterns, and prepare better questions for your care team. It does not diagnose, treat, or prescribe.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq2Q: What data does it have access to?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq2A: Everything in your xHeal profile: vitals from Apple Health, uploaded lab results, medical records, logged symptoms, medications, supplements, routines, and life events. The more you share, the more complete the picture.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq3A: Yes. Our LLM partner follows a zero-retention, zero-training policy. They do not store your personal data or use it to train models. You can delete your chat history at any time.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq4Q: What medical standards does xHeal use?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq4A: xHeal interprets health data through guidelines from the World Health Organization (WHO), American Diabetes Association (ADA), European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD), and others.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq5Q: Can I share insights with my care team?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq5A: Yes. xHeal generates specialist-ready reports – Why Finder, My Snapshot, Clinical Report, and Health Gaps – designed specifically for sharing with your care team.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.ctaSubtitle: Download xHeal and meet your Digital Twin. The more you share, the smarter it gets.

Feature_FlareUp.heroTitle: Stop reacting to flare-ups. <accent>Start predicting them.</accent>
Feature_FlareUp.heroSubtitle: xHeal cross-references your symptoms, sleep, stress, nutrition, and activity data to find what triggers your flare-ups, then warns you before the next one hits.
Feature_FlareUp.heroImageAlt: xHeal Flare-Up Detection - predictive pattern analysis across symptoms, sleep, stress, and activity
Feature_FlareUp.painHeading: You know something triggers it. You just can’t <accent>figure out what.</accent>
Feature_FlareUp.pain1Detail: Was it the food? The stress? The bad sleep? When a flare-up hits, you retrace your steps but never find the real cause because the pattern spans days, not hours.
Feature_FlareUp.pain2Title: The same cycle, over and over
Feature_FlareUp.pain2Detail: Good week, bad week, good week, bad week. You can feel the rhythm but you can’t break it because you don’t know which variable to change.
Feature_FlareUp.pain3Title: By the time you notice, it’s too late
Feature_FlareUp.pain3Detail: Flare-ups don’t announce themselves. By the time symptoms hit, you’re already in it. What if you could catch the warning signs 24 to 48 hours earlier?
Feature_FlareUp.how1Description: Log symptoms, meals, sleep, stress, medications, and activity. xHeal also pulls data from Apple Health and your wearables automatically.
Feature_FlareUp.how2Description: Our AI cross-references 250+ parameters over time to identify triggers and early warning signals unique to your body.
Feature_FlareUp.how3Description: When xHeal detects a familiar pattern forming, it alerts you with enough time to intervene, change course, and potentially prevent the flare-up entirely.
Feature_FlareUp.useCasesHeading: Patterns your Digital Twin <accent>can uncover for you</accent>
Feature_FlareUp.uc1Question: Why do I always crash on Wednesdays?
Feature_FlareUp.uc1Description: xHeal maps your weekly patterns and shows how Monday’s choices ripple into Wednesday’s symptoms.
Feature_FlareUp.uc2Question: Is gluten actually a trigger for me?
Feature_FlareUp.uc2Description: Stop guessing. xHeal correlates your food logs with symptom timing to confirm or rule out suspected triggers.
Feature_FlareUp.uc3Question: Does poor sleep make my symptoms worse?
Feature_FlareUp.uc3Description: See exactly how sleep quality, duration, and timing affect your symptom severity the next day.
Feature_FlareUp.uc4Question: What combination of factors sets me off?
Feature_FlareUp.uc4Description: Most flare-ups have multiple triggers. xHeal identifies the specific combinations that precede your worst days.
Feature_FlareUp.uc5Question: Am I improving or just having a good week?
Feature_FlareUp.uc5Description: Track your flare-up frequency and severity over months. See real progress, not just random variation.
Feature_FlareUp.uc6Question: What should I avoid this week?
Feature_FlareUp.uc6Description: Based on your current data trends, xHeal highlights the highest-risk factors for this week and suggests what to watch.
Feature_FlareUp.compIntro: Wellness trackers help you record how you feel. That’s useful. But recording isn’t preventing. xHeal goes further: it cross-references your symptoms with your sleep, stress, nutrition, activity, and clinical data to find patterns and warns you before a flare-up develops.
Feature_FlareUp.compClosingLine: WHOOP tracks your strain. Bevel tracks your recovery. Olivia organizes your records. Only xHeal connects it all to predict what’s coming.
Feature_FlareUp.testimonialsHeading: They stopped guessing. <accent>xHeal showed them why.</accent>
Feature_FlareUp.test1Quote: I’ve had IBS for years. xHeal showed me that my flare-ups spike 48 hours after combining dairy and poor sleep. Not one or the other – both together.
Feature_FlareUp.test2Quote: xHeal caught a pattern I missed for 3 years: my migraines correlate with low HRV plus skipped meals. My neurologist confirmed it makes sense.
Feature_FlareUp.test3Quote: Got a warning on Tuesday that my pattern looked like a flare-up was building. Changed my routine, slept more, and Thursday was fine. That never happens.
Feature_FlareUp.trust1Detail: Flare-up data, triggers, and symptom logs are encrypted and visible only to you. We never share health patterns with third parties.
Feature_FlareUp.trust2Detail: xHeal uses WHO, ADA, and EASD guidelines to interpret patterns, not generic wellness algorithms.
Feature_FlareUp.trust3Detail: Delete any symptom log, trigger, or pattern analysis at any time. Your data, your rules.
Feature_FlareUp.trust4Detail: We don’t monetize your health data. Our business model is the product, not your personal information.
Feature_FlareUp.faq1A: xHeal analyzes patterns across your symptoms, sleep, stress, nutrition, activity, and clinical data over time. When it detects a combination of factors that preceded previous flare-ups, it alerts you early.
Feature_FlareUp.faq2Q: How early can it warn me?
Feature_FlareUp.faq2A: It depends on your patterns. Some users see warnings 24 to 48 hours before a flare-up. The more data xHeal has, the earlier and more accurate the warnings become.
Feature_FlareUp.faq3Q: What conditions does it work for?
Feature_FlareUp.faq3A: Flare-up detection works for any condition with recurring episodes: IBS, migraines, eczema, fibromyalgia, autoimmune conditions, and more. If it has a pattern, xHeal can find it.
Feature_FlareUp.faq4A: No. xHeal identifies patterns and correlations in your data to help you and your care team understand triggers. It does not diagnose conditions or replace clinical care.
Feature_FlareUp.faq5Q: How much data does it need?
Feature_FlareUp.faq5A: Pattern detection improves with more data. Most users start seeing initial insights within 2 to 4 weeks of consistent tracking.
Feature_FlareUp.ctaSubtitle: Download xHeal and start uncovering the patterns behind your flare-ups.

Feature_HealthAwareness.heroTitle: See the <accent>full picture</accent> of your health
Feature_HealthAwareness.heroSubtitle: xHeal connects your sleep, mood, nutrition, activity, medical records, and lab results into one clear Health Awareness score – so you always know where you stand.
Feature_HealthAwareness.heroImageAlt: xHeal Health Awareness - see your complete health score across all domains
Feature_HealthAwareness.painHeading: Six health domains. Zero places that connect them, <accent>until now.</accent>
Feature_HealthAwareness.pain1Title: Health is more than one number
Feature_HealthAwareness.pain1Detail: Your GP checks cholesterol. Your watch tracks steps. Your app counts calories. But no one connects them. Real health awareness means seeing how everything fits together.
Feature_HealthAwareness.pain2Detail: Each specialist sees their slice. Your GP gets 15 minutes. Nobody has the time or tools to connect your sleep patterns with your lab results and your stress levels.
Feature_HealthAwareness.pain3Title: You can’t improve what you can’t see
Feature_HealthAwareness.pain3Detail: Without a unified view, you’re guessing which area of your health needs attention most. Small issues go unnoticed until they become big problems.
Feature_HealthAwareness.howHeading: From scattered data to <accent>a single score</accent>
Feature_HealthAwareness.how1Description: Import medical records, sync Apple Health, connect wearables, log symptoms and lifestyle data. xHeal brings it all into one secure place.
Feature_HealthAwareness.how2Description: Our AI analyzes data across six domains – mental, physical, nutrition, medical, sleep, and activity – to create a comprehensive picture of your wellbeing.
Feature_HealthAwareness.how3Description: See a clear 0–100 score that reflects your overall health awareness, with breakdowns by domain and specific recommendations to improve.
Feature_HealthAwareness.useCasesHeading: See where you stand. <accent>Know where to focus.</accent>
Feature_HealthAwareness.uc1Question: How is my overall health trending?
Feature_HealthAwareness.uc1Description: See your Health Awareness score over time and understand whether you’re moving in the right direction.
Feature_HealthAwareness.uc2Question: What area needs the most attention?
Feature_HealthAwareness.uc2Description: xHeal highlights which health domain is lagging and suggests where to focus your energy for the biggest impact.
Feature_HealthAwareness.uc3Description: Track changes week over week and month over month. See concrete evidence of your progress, not just feelings.
Feature_HealthAwareness.uc4Question: How does my sleep affect everything else?
Feature_HealthAwareness.uc4Description: Understand how one area of your health ripples across others. Sleep, stress, nutrition, and activity are more connected than you think.
